_comment: Base-layer skills vendored from upstream at install time, installed alongside the portable Linchpin skills in ./skills. Edit `skills` below to curate which generic skills ship. `path` is where skills live inside the source repo (default `skills`) — upstreams disagree, so set it when a repo keeps them elsewhere. Pin `ref` to a commit SHA (neither upstream publishes releases); bump it deliberately and re-test. Licenses differ per source and are recorded below; redistribution is fine with attribution (see README).

sources._comment: Our fork of Automattic/docspress, not upstream: the fork's generator reads the per-repo .docspress/brief.md contract that skills/docspress-publish relies on, so the two are not interchangeable. That wrapper owns the docs.linchpin.com target and defers content generation here. `path` is .agents/skills because upstream maintains that copy and lets .claude/skills fall behind.
sources.name: linchpin/docspress
